criteria.reference_control: 30/30 diagnostic passes and 30/30 evaluation inputs correct
criteria.transport: every row is tree-terminated and not timed out

protocol.purpose: hand-built expression defect coverage check against the frozen banks

scope: Hand-built expression defect coverage only. No model-generated solver was requested or executed. A pass supports only the claim that these frozen banks detect the prespecified hand-built defects under the stated gate. It is not evidence that natural solvers concentrate failures, that C predicts correctness, or that the task is easy.

variants.defect: evaluates all binary operators strictly left-to-right
reads only one digit per integer literal
does not skip whitespace between tokens
